app_context: Business Card OCR & Smart Contact Management (Mobile Expo React Native)

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant for Mobile.

scale.caption: 12px (leading 16px) - uppercase for overlines with wide letter spacing (tracking-wide)

typography.instructions: Use @expo-google-fonts/manrope and @expo-google-fonts/ibm-plex-sans. Headings must use bold weights (700) for contrast. Do not use generic fonts for headers.

colors.instructions: No purple gradients. Use the deep slate (primary brand) for core actions, and the Emerald Green (#10B981) specifically for 'Enrichment/AI' badges, success states, and quick conversion actions. Ensure dark mode is a first-class citizen using deep midnight blues, not pure black.

spacing_and_layout.screen_padding: 24px on left/right for premium breathing room.

patterns.bottom_sheet: Use draggable bottom sheets for secondary content (settings, filters, confirmations) instead of full-screen takeovers. Anchored for thumb access.
patterns.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44 points for all interactive elements to ensure finger precision.
patterns.cards: Subtle border (1px solid border) and flat styling. No heavy drop shadows. Corner radius: 16px.
patterns.navigation: Bottom tab bar with 5 icons. The center 'Scan' icon should be an elevated FAB (Floating Action Button) with a distinct styling (Emerald or Deep Slate) to prioritize the core action.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (fully rounded) or 12px radius. Height: 48px or 56px for primary actions.
components.inputs: Filled background (surface color) with bottom border or subtle 1px full border. Height: 52px. Mobile-first forms (numeric pads for phone numbers).
components.chips: Horizontal scroll view for filter chips (All, Recent, Tagged). Pill shaped, subtle background when inactive, deep solid background when active.
components.ocr_review_screen: Top 40% of screen shows cropped image of business card. Bottom 60% is a scrollable form with editable fields. Display a shiny 'AI Enriched' badge (Emerald color) near company details.
components.contact_detail: Hero header with large avatar/initials. Primary quick actions (Call, Email) immediately below avatar. Sticky tab layout for Info/Notes/Activity/Enrichment.

motion_and_interactions.guidelines: Smooth, professional transitions. Use React Native Reanimated if applicable.
motion_and_interactions.ocr_scan: Provide a visual scanning line overlay (laser edge-detection guide) that moves up and down during camera active state.

onboarding_auth.description: Professional man and woman discussing work over coffee in a trendy café. Use for welcome/onboarding screen.

empty_contacts.description: Empty white paper sheet placed near a ceramic vase. Use for 'No Contacts Yet' state.

scanning_empty.description: Close up of a camera lens. Use as a placeholder or abstract background for the scan prep screen.

empty_analytics.description: Sleek laptop showcasing data analytics and graphs. Use for empty state in Campaigns/Analytics dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React Native (Expo) views utilizing standard components like View, Text, ScrollView, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, FlatList.
If using a styling library like NativeWind, apply Tailwind class mappings as per the color and typography specs. If using StyleSheet, manually map the design tokens.
Ensure the central 'Scan' tab acts as an elevated Floating Action Button overlaying the bottom tab bar.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, tabs, and form inputs.
Implement a robust 'Bottom Sheet' architecture for the 'Filter Contacts' and 'Add/Edit Contact' flows instead of standard navigation push where feasible.
For the 'OCR Review' screen, implement a split view layout: Image on top, form on bottom. Include confidence indicators.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers/modals where content scrolls beneath. Use platform blur effects (e.g. Expo BlurView) or opaque backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and bottom sheets.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use standard professional icons (e.g. Lucide Icons via lucide-react-native).
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use provided image URLs.
